headlines.text: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal. Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.
Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army. A desperate junta is in a war of attrition against ethnic militias and and civilian resistance.
Delhi sees more protests as 'cockroach' group's leaders released. Police say they will keep restricting access to the city centre after thousands of people were detained and released on Saturday.
US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage. The White House had blocked access for CNN, MS Now and Politico, leading them to restrict pool coverage.

Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US. Roofs were ripped off buildings after Isaias barrelled into the US on Friday evening, before it weakened to a post-tropical cyclone.
Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island. The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.

US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution. Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.
Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people. Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students. Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.

Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week. Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.
Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'. Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".

Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case. Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.
Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says. Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.
What can Man City expect against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday?. Man City face Liverpool in their first game since being found guilty of serious EPL financial breaches.
Trump calls for Ukraine election, says Zelenskyy failed to end war. Trump has called for Ukraine to hold elections, implying Zelenskyy missed opportunities to end the war with Russia.

What the Iran war has done to the world’s energy supply, in charts. Fossil fuels produce 81 percent of global energy. We look at Middle East’s role and what happens when supplies are cut.

Flash flood sweeps away buildings in Nepal. Flash flooding in Nepal has swept away buildings along the Budhi Gandaki river on Sunday.
Vinicius apologises for hair-pull red card but could miss El Clasico. Real Madrid forward has a goal disallowed, is sent off for the hair-pull offence and could miss the next three games.
How genocidal war on Gaza is shaping Israel’s election. Israel’s election signals not a demand for change, but deeper entrenchment of the jingoism unleashed after October 7.
US opens antitrust probe into TV networks for halting Trump coverage. Department of Justice says it's investigating whether the White House press pool's decision violated antitrust laws.
Hurricane Isaias kills four, leaves 650,000 without power in Florida. Hurricane Isaias has killed four people and left more than 650,000 people without power.
